findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of work and deliverables under the agreement, specifying the responsibilities of the Vendor.
evidence_excerpts: Vendor shall supply the Hardware as per specifications in Annexure A. Vendor shall provide installation, configuration, and integration services. Vendor shall provide training to Client staff for a period of 2 weeks post-installation.

findings.title: Acceptance Criteria for Deliverables
findings.rationale: The evidence discusses the payment schedule tied to acceptance testing, indicating that acceptance criteria are part of the agreement.
evidence_excerpts: Client requested milestone-based payments tied to acceptance testing rather than delivery date.

findings.title: Service Level Commitments
findings.rationale: The vendor commits to a service uptime SLA of 99.9%, which was a request from the client, indicating a performance commitment under the agreement.
evidence_excerpts: Client requested inclusion of service uptime SLA of 99.9% (Vendor initially proposed 98%).
